items.q: What industries does AKAM Machine build for?
items.a: We design and build equipment for mining and mineral processing, metal and foundry industries, engineering services, and agricultural machinery.
Yes. We start from your requirements or drawings and handle 3D design, machining, welding, hydraulics and industrial electrics in one workshop.

items.q: What does the project process look like?
items.a: Requirements and design, drawings and fabrication, and finally assembly, performance testing and delivery of the equipment.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Contact our sales team from the Contact section and describe your need, and we will provide technical advice and pricing.

items.q: Do you supply spare parts and after-sales service?
items.a: Yes, parts supply and equipment rebuilding are part of our services. Contact us for details.
